summary: POMDOCTOR Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing a change in its American Depositary Share (ADS) ratio, effective June 22, 2026. The ratio changes from one ADS representing 1/6 Class A ordinary share to one ADS representing three Class A ordinary shares, equivalent to a 1-for-18 reverse ADS split. No change to Class A ordinary shares. Holders will have every 18 existing ADSs automatically exchanged for one new ADS; fractional entitlements sold and net proceeds distributed. The depositary is Citibank, N.A. ADSs will trade under the same ticker 'POM' on Nasdaq. This is an administrative corporate action, not a special situation.
